headline: Only 58.6 % work full-time, far below benchmarks, with part-time and self-employment clearly elevated.

key_findings: Full-time work is 58.6 %, part-time 20.7 % and self-employed 13.8 %; other employment, not seeking work, student and retired are 0.0 %.
Both totals and seeking work are hidden (fewer than 3 people).
benchmark: Full-time work is 15.6 pp below the regional 74.2 % and 16.3 pp below all schools (74.9 %). Part-time work is 10.5 pp above the region (10.2 %), and self-employment 6.6 pp above its 7.2 %.
caveats: With n = 29, percentages move by several points per person; the pattern may be worth exploring with fuller data.
